capabilities: Publish notes to Ghost posts via configured presets
Triage and queue candidate notes in a side panel
Upload embedded images and rewrite them as Ghost image cards
Convert wikilinks, YouTube links, LINK blocks and footnotes to Ghost cards and anchors
Record Ghost post ids and hash note bodies to skip unchanged notes during sync
extras: Desktop-only and requires Obsidian 1.13.0 or later (declarative settings API); full user and technical documentation live on GitHub Pages rather than in the README; stores the Admin API key in device-local secret storage with an optional GHOST_ADMIN_KEY environment fallback.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in way to publish notes to a Ghost blog with configurable tags, newsletter dispatch and conflict-free updates.

relations.evidence: Ghost Admin API at your configured Ghost URL — for creating / updating posts, fetching tags & newsletters

summary: Publishing tool that sends vault notes to a Ghost blog using per-preset tags, newsletters, triage queues and idempotent syncing.
